summary.text: Lukas Schubert is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 8 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Schubert attended Flathead Valley Community College and has been affiliated with the Flathead County Transportation Advisory Committee and the Flathead County Republican Central Committee.

He won the District 8 seat in 2024, defeating Beth Sibert, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the State Administration, Natural Resources, Fish, Wildlife and Parks, and Legislative Administration committees.
